breakdown.description: The boundary condition of fixedValue (0 0.1 0) is set at outlet, but it should be the inlet.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly assigns the fixedValue boundary conditions (velocity of air to fixedValue (0 0.1 0), velocity of water to fixedValue (0 0 0), volume fractions, and temperatures) to the inlet, matching the ground truth. While the generated spec also retains similar conditions at the outlet (which the ground truth doesn't explicitly specify), the core inconsistency — that these conditions should be at the inlet rather than only at the outlet — is resolved.
